classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkService
classes.description: Service class providing functionalities for tracking and summarizing employee work hours, last punch actions, and weekly attendance data within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getTimeAtWorkResults
methods.description: Retrieves weekly work data and metadata for a given employee at specific times.

methods.name: getTimeAtWorkMetaData
methods.description: Generates metadata including last action details, current day and week totals, and user info.

methods.name: getDateDetails
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a date and label.

methods.name: getTimeInHoursAndMinutes
methods.description: Converts total minutes into hours and minutes.

methods.name: getLastActionDetails
methods.description: Fetches and formats the last punch action (in/out) of an employee.

methods.name: getTotalTimeForGivenDate
methods.description: Calculates total worked time for a specific date range, considering punch-in/out records.

methods.name: getDataForCurrentWeek
methods.description: Collects daily work durations over the current week for an employee.

methods.name: getTimeDifference
methods.description: Calculates difference in minutes between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: getDateTimeInUTC
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to UTC timezone.

methods.name: getCurrentUserData
methods.description: Retrieves basic information about the current user/employee.

methods.name: getWeekStartDateIndex
methods.description: Lazy loads the starting day index for a work week for reporting purposes.
